scope: WORK ONLY; no browser execution, no local integration, no publication
sourceFixes: Both real ArrayBuffer FontFace loads and seven SVG Image decodes precede authored application initialization.
Readiness waits FBX/EXR VAT decoding, an actual spawned paper mesh using the unchanged timed entrance, and genuine first draw with GL error check.
Source stop suspends pending entrance timers with remaining delay; no 150ms polling loop remains. Dispose rejects pending readiness and clears timers, gestures, fonts and scene resources.
loaderAudit: Fonts: fetch local TTF -> ArrayBuffer -> FontFace; compatible with broker and does not require font URL fetch.
VAT: local FBX/EXR -> FileLoader Request/fetch -> broker -> CPU decode. FBX is ASCII and has no active external Texture/Video reference.
Design SVGs: native Image.src -> broker blob -> canvas texture. fflate Worker definitions exist in bundled library but the active synchronous decode path has no worker invocation.
renderer: Three160 WebGLRenderer with SSAO/shadows; EXR FloatType is CPU-decoded into geometry, not a float-texture GPU rendering requirement.
nativeInput: Native pointer capture for click/drag/release; lostpointercapture, blur and stop cancel gestures. No synthetic input.
reducedMotion: No falling entrance or physics under reduced motion; direct dragging remains, open/discard transitions snap.
initializationContract: ready is a Promise; all required active resource loads plus scene initialization and actual first draw precede succeed; load/draw/GL errors reject; no load-event or timeout readiness
disposalContract: idempotent Promise; own RAF/timers/listeners/resources cleaned; host frame destruction remains final isolation boundary
